# Nirman Media

> Nirman Media is a premium media studio in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. We make cinematic brand films, magazine-grade commercial photography, interactive 3D scrollytelling tours, and fast conversion-focused websites for spaces that need to sell — real estate projects, hotels, resorts, restaurants, and gyms. Most projects are delivered in 7 days. 50+ brands shot since 2021, 4.9★ Google rating.

Key facts:
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (serves all of India)
- Services and starting prices: Brand Films ₹85,000 (7-day delivery) · Photography ₹45,000 (5 days) · 3D Scrolly Tours ₹65,000 (10 days) · Brand Websites ₹1,20,000 (14 days)
- Notable results: The Aurum Hotel +120% direct bookings; Skyline Residences sold 32 flats in 18 days; Bistro Maharaj 3× reservations after launch
- Contact: hello@nirmanmedia.com · WhatsApp +91 91669 21692 · Mon–Sat 10am–8pm
- Founder: Nirvan
